text:
lena: Heads-up: AcmeCorp POC can't finish onboarding. IdP is sending NameID as 'transient' and our SCIM connector is getting users but no roles/groups. They need Dedicated pool access by next week for load tests. Can we triage?
omar: Transient NameID usually means the IdP issues opaque session identifiers. We expect persistent/email for account mapping. Can you grab a raw assertion?
lena: They shared this snippet (sanitized):
```xml
<saml:NameID Format=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:transient\">_abc.DEF.ghi
</saml:NameID>
```
They say switching to emailAddress impacts their legacy SSO.
vikas: On SCIM, are we seeing group objects or are they using a custom attribute like 'roles'? Our connector expects 'members' array on group resources.
lena: SCIM group sample from their IdP (truncated):
```json
{
  "Resources": [
    {
      "displayName": "eng-backend",
      "roles": ["owner","contributor"],
      "members": null
    }
  ]
}
```
vikas: Aha, they put roles on the group not members. We can map 'roles' to group membership only if IdP also exports user references. If members=null it's not doing full group sync. Ask their IdP admin to enable full group sync or map groupMembership to a multivalued claim.
security-bot: Quick security note: temporary Hosted API keys are allowed for POCs if scoped, TTL <= 72h, and audit logs enabled. No long-lived creds. Also request for customer: include KMS usage and SOC2 attestation on the questionnaire.
lena: Customer asked whether we can issue a temp key while they sort SAML. They want it noted in their security review.
deploy-bot: [notice] Temp API key created: poc-acmecorp-24h-zz99 (expires in 24h). Owner: lena.
infra-eng: On Dedicated pool: I can provision a small reserved pool (4x A10G) in 3 business days if networking signed-off. Private/VPC deployment will take 2-3 weeks including peering and firewall config. Opened ticket IR-4721 to start resource allocation.
ovar: (typo) omar: Also confirm whether customer's firewall or proxy rewrites SCIM request bodies; some enterprises flatten arrays. If they do, SCIM members can become comma-separated strings.
lena: Good point. I'm asking for: 1) IdP assertion with email and group claims, 2) screenshot of SCIM provisioning settings, 3) firewall/proxy egress rules.
vikas: For short-term we can: 1) accept temp API key for dev flow, 2) provide a minimal transformation mapping on our side to accept 'roles' if it contains user ids (quick hack, engineering-approved), 3) start Dedicated pool ticket.
infra-eng: Confirmed IR-4721 created. Estimated ready-by 3 business days if peering isn't blocked. Need their VPC CIDR and peering contact.
security-bot: I'll append the QA note to their questionnaire: list temp key id, TTL, audit bucket, and that production SSO requires persistent NameID or email claim plus MFA.
lena: Thanks. I'll return to the customer with the temp key and the Dedicated ETA, and request the IdP screenshots and firewall rules. Will post updates here. :thumbsup:
